questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The history of a famous BBC music programme
How to become a famous singer quickly
How words and music make hit songs
Why hip-hop is more popular than rock music
questions.why: Neil says they'll be discussing the art of songwriting – combining lyrics and music to make a hit.

questions.q: Why is Neil singing at the start?
options: A song has been stuck in his head all day
He is practising for a concert tonight
He wrote a new song for the programme
Sam asked him to sing her favourite song
questions.why: He says he's had this song stuck in his head all day.

questions.q: According to Sam, what makes writing a memorable song difficult?
options: Finding a good band to play with
Recording it cheaply at home
Getting it played on the radio
A good tune that matches the words
questions.why: She says you have to write a good tune and match it to the lyrics.

questions.q: What kind of music is Professor Adam Bradley listening to now?
options: Only new hip-hop songs from this year
Music from his youth, like his mother's
Classical music, mostly Mozart
Songs by The Rolling Stones only
questions.why: He says he goes back to the earliest music that mattered to him, like music his mother played.

questions.q: What did Keith Richards often wake up with after a night of partying?
options: A finished set of lyrics in a notebook
A letter from Mick Jagger about the band
A recording of a melody and chords
A new guitar from a fan
questions.why: Adam says he'd wake up with a recording device where he'd put down a melody and chord structure.

questions.q: What was Mick Jagger's role in writing songs?
options: He played most of the guitar parts
He listened to Keith's music and wrote lyrics
He recorded the songs alone in his studio
He chose which songs the band would release
questions.why: Adam says Mick would listen through and write lyrics.

questions.q: How does Adam describe Mick and Keith's way of working together?
options: Give and take, with some tension
Keith made all of the big decisions
They never disagreed about anything
They wrote their songs separately
questions.why: He says there was 'this give and take, this tension'.

questions.q: What does Sam say about Mick and Keith's friendship?
options: It ended many years ago
It has always been perfect
It started after they became famous
It has had good and bad times
questions.why: She says their legendary friendship has certainly been up and down over the years.
